objectives.statement: Form the imperative by using the verb stem for regular -e verbs.
Recognize short verbs whose infinitive and imperative look the same after å is removed.
Use the imperative without a subject in short commands and requests.
Understand simple negative and polite imperatives with ikke and vær så snill.

notes: Must teach the basic imperative as the verb stem, including short verbs where infinitive and imperative look the same.
